at 2026-07-12T12:00:00Z
exec card init --prefix graph-
exec sh -c 'printf "version: 1\nissue:\n  id:\n    prefix: graph-\n    strategy: sequential\n" > .cardamom/config.yaml'

exec card create --type workstream 'Parent workstream'
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/create-parent.txt
exec card create 'Child task'
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/create-child.txt

exec card edit graph-2 --parent graph-1
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/attach.txt

# Containment does not create a dependency or block the child.
exec card --json show graph-2
cmpjson stdout $WORK/golden/child.json

exec card edit graph-2 --parent=
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/detach.txt
exec card --json show graph-2
cmpjson stdout $WORK/golden/unparented.json
